questions.q: Which flowchart symbol is used to show a yes/no question?
questions.why: A diamond is a decision with two exits; rectangle is process, parallelogram is input/output.

questions.q: What is the value of 29 MOD 4?
questions.why: 29 ÷ 4 = 7 remainder 1, and MOD gives the remainder.

questions.q: Which loop is guaranteed to run at least once?
questions.why: REPEAT…UNTIL tests its condition at the end, after the body has run once.

questions.q: Describe what is meant by abstraction and give an example.
questions.model: Abstraction is removing unnecessary detail and keeping only the features needed to solve the problem. For example, a tube map shows stations and connections but not real distances or streets.
